question.:question/worked-solution:
Let $u=\tan{\left(x \right)}$ and $v=x^{2}.$ Then

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{\text{d}u}{\text{d}x}&=\tan^{2}{\left(x \right)} + 1\,\text{and}\,\frac{\text{d}v}{\text{d}x}=2 x.\end{aligned}
$$

Using the quotient rule, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{\text{d}y}{\text{d}x}&=\frac{v\frac{\text{d}u}{\text{d}x}-u\frac{\text{d}v}{\text{d}x}}{v^{2}}\\ &=\frac{(x^{2})\cdot (\tan^{2}{\left(x \right)} + 1)-(\tan{\left(x \right)})\cdot (2 x)}{(x^{2})^{2}}\\ &=\frac{x(x \sec^{2}{\left(x \right)} - 2 \tan{\left(x \right)})}{x^{4}}\\ &=\frac{1}{x^{3}}\cdot (x \sec^{2}{\left(x \right)} - 2 \tan{\left(x \right)}).\end{aligned}
$$

question.:question/worked-solution:
Let $u=e^{x}$ and $v=x + 1.$ Then

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{\text{d}u}{\text{d}x}&=e^{x}\,\text{and}\,\frac{\text{d}v}{\text{d}x}=1.\end{aligned}
$$

Using the quotient rule, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{\text{d}y}{\text{d}x}&=\frac{v\frac{\text{d}u}{\text{d}x}-u\frac{\text{d}v}{\text{d}x}}{v^{2}}\\ &=\frac{(x + 1)\cdot (e^{x})-(e^{x})\cdot (1)}{(x + 1)^{2}}\\ &=\frac{e^{x}(x+1-1)}{(x + 1)^{2}}\\ &=\frac{x e^{x}}{\left(x + 1\right)^{2}}.\end{aligned}
$$

question.:question/worked-solution:
Let $u=\log_{3}x=\frac{\ln x}{\ln 3}$ and $v=x^{2}.$ Then

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{\text{d}u}{\text{d}x}&=\frac{1}{x \ln{\left(3 \right)}}\,\text{and}\,\frac{\text{d}v}{\text{d}x}=2 x.\end{aligned}
$$

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{\text{d}y}{\text{d}x}&=\frac{v\frac{\text{d}u}{\text{d}x}-u\frac{\text{d}v}{\text{d}x}}{v^{2}}\\ &=\frac{(x^{2})\cdot (\frac{1}{x \ln{\left(3 \right)}})-(\frac{\ln{\left(x \right)}}{\ln{\left(3 \right)}})\cdot (2 x)}{(x^{2})^{2}}\\ &=\frac{\frac{x}{\ln{\left(3 \right)}}-\frac{2 x \ln{\left(x \right)}}{\ln{\left(3 \right)}}}{x^{4}}\\ &=\frac{x-2 x \ln{\left(x \right)}}{x^{4}\ln{\left(3 \right)}}\\ &=\frac{x(1 - 2 \ln{\left(x \right)})}{x^{4}\ln{\left(3 \right)}}\\ &=\frac{1 - 2 \ln{\left(x \right)}}{x^{3} \ln{\left(3 \right)}}\\ &=(1 - 2 \ln{\left(x \right)})\cdot \frac{1}{x^{3} \ln{\left(3 \right)}}.\end{aligned}
$$

question.:question/worked-solution:
Let $u=1 - \sin{\left(x \right)}$ and $v=\sin{\left(x \right)}.$ Then

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{\text{d}u}{\text{d}x}&=- \cos{\left(x \right)}\,\text{and}\,\frac{\text{d}v}{\text{d}x}=\cos{\left(x \right)}.\end{aligned}
$$

Using the quotient rule, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{\text{d}y}{\text{d}x}&=\frac{v\frac{\text{d}u}{\text{d}x}-u\frac{\text{d}v}{\text{d}x}}{v^{2}}\\ &=\frac{(\sin{\left(x \right)})\cdot (- \cos{\left(x \right)})-(1 - \sin{\left(x \right)})\cdot (\cos{\left(x \right)})}{(\sin{\left(x \right)})^{2}}\\ &=\frac{\cos{\left(x \right)}(- \sin{\left(x \right)}-1+\sin{\left(x \right)})}{\sin^{2} x}\\ &=\frac{\cos{\left(x \right)}\cdot (-1)}{\sin^{2} x}\\ &=-1\frac{1}{\sin{\left(x \right)}}\cdot \frac{\cos{\left(x \right)}}{\sin{\left(x \right)}}\\ &=- \cot{\left(x \right)} \csc{\left(x \right)}.\end{aligned}
$$

question.:question/worked-solution:
Let $u=\log_{3}x=\frac{\ln x}{\ln 3}$ and $v=x^{4}.$ Then

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{\text{d}u}{\text{d}x}&=\frac{1}{x \ln{\left(3 \right)}}\,\text{and}\,\frac{\text{d}v}{\text{d}x}=4 x^{3}.\end{aligned}
$$

Using the quotient rule, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{\text{d}y}{\text{d}x}&=\frac{v\frac{\text{d}u}{\text{d}x}-u\frac{\text{d}v}{\text{d}x}}{v^{2}}\\ &=\frac{(x^{4})\cdot (\frac{1}{x \ln{\left(3 \right)}})-(\frac{\ln{\left(x \right)}}{\ln{\left(3 \right)}})\cdot (4 x^{3})}{(x^{4})^{2}}\\ &=\frac{\frac{x^{3}}{\ln{\left(3 \right)}}-\frac{4 x^{3} \ln{\left(x \right)}}{\ln{\left(3 \right)}}}{x^{8}}\\ &=\frac{x^{3}-4 x^{3} \ln{\left(x \right)}}{x^{8}\ln{\left(3 \right)}}\\ &=\frac{x^{3}(1 - 4 \ln{\left(x \right)})}{x^{8}\ln{\left(3 \right)}}\\ &=\frac{1 - 4 \ln{\left(x \right)}}{x^{5} \ln{\left(3 \right)}}\\ &=(1 - 4 \ln{\left(x \right)})\cdot \frac{1}{x^{5} \ln{\left(3 \right)}}.\end{aligned}
$$

question.:question/worked-solution:
Let $u=10 \cos{\left(x \right)} + 10$ and $v=\sin{\left(x \right)}.$ Then

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{\text{d}u}{\text{d}x}&=- 10 \sin{\left(x \right)}\,\text{and}\,\frac{\text{d}v}{\text{d}x}=\cos{\left(x \right)}.\end{aligned}
$$

Using the quotient rule, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{\text{d}y}{\text{d}x}&=\frac{v\frac{\text{d}u}{\text{d}x}-u\frac{\text{d}v}{\text{d}x}}{v^{2}}\\ &=\frac{(\sin{\left(x \right)})\cdot (- 10 \sin{\left(x \right)})-(10 \cos{\left(x \right)} + 10)\cdot (\cos{\left(x \right)})}{(\sin{\left(x \right)})^{2}}\\ &=\frac{- 10 \sin^{2}{\left(x \right)} - 10 \cos^{2}{\left(x \right)} - 10 \cos{\left(x \right)}}{\sin^{2}x}\\ &=- \frac{10}{1 - \cos{\left(x \right)}}.\end{aligned}
$$
